Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step:

Hint 1: Consider the shape of the scatterplot. Does it resemble a linear, quadratic, or some other type of relationship? This will help you determine which function f(x) could potentially fit the data.

Hint 2: Evaluate each function option (A to D) and think about how they transform the input $$x$$. For example, f(x) $$=$$ $$x^2$$ will create a parabolic shape, while f(x) $$=$$ |x| will create a V-shape. Compare these transformations to the pattern in the scatterplot to see if any match.
